verticalDatum: Published Wien OGD height datum: Wiener Null (EPSG8881),156.68m above Adria. Values remain unconverted; Y0 is18.85m Wiener Null sampled at the Michaeler-passage working origin,not a surveyed palace floor.
attribution: Datenquelle: Stadt Wien - data.wien.gv.at; map plan ©OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0.
limits: 1m DGM resampled to5m native contact fixture. Under-roof DGM does not survey occupied floors or underground rooms.
Acquisition vintage and absolute vertical accuracy are not verified; grid delivery files are dated2026-09-30.
Published horizontal transformation accuracy is reported by pyproj; precise facade/stair location requires survey.
Albertina terrace is supplied by terrain; model must not duplicate the filled bastion.
Working wing floors are boundary quantiles with a small reconstructed clearance, not authoritative entrance elevations.
